ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon LOTL reconnaissance chain on edge/internal hosts (wmic + net + systeminfo + ipconfig within short window)
ucs.description: Hunts Volt Typhoon's signature living-off-the-land (LOTL) host reconnaissance burst executed from a single shell session — wmic/net/systeminfo/ipconfig/tasklist/netstat/quser running back-to-back under one parent. CISA's joint advisory (AA24-038A) on Volt Typhoon specifically calls out this exact combination of built-in Windows binaries used for situational awareness on compromised SOHO/edge devices and downstream critical-infrastructure hosts.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as recon_bins dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","ping.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","netsh.exe","reg.exe","hostname.exe","qprocess.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_bins >= 5 AND parent_process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","conhost.exe","explorer.exe","w3wp.exe","sshd.exe","wsmprovhost.exe") | rename firstTime as _time | convert ctime(_time) ctime(lastTime) | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon / Voltzite LOTL host-recon burst — CISA AA24-038A
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let ReconBins = dynamic(["wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","ping.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","netsh.exe","reg.exe","hostname.exe","qprocess.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend ParentKey = strcat(DeviceId, "|", tostring(InitiatingProcessId), "|", tostring(InitiatingProcessCreationTime))
| summarize
    ReconBinsRun = make_set(FileName, 32),
    DistinctBins = dcount(FileName),
    SampleCmds   = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16),
    FirstSeen    = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen     = max(Timestamp),
    BurstWindow  = bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
  by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentKey, BurstWindow
| where DistinctBins >= 5                  // burst-of-5 = empirical Volt Typhoon recon chain
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","explorer.exe","w3wp.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","sshd.exe")
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, DistinctBins, ReconBinsRun, SampleCmds
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon LOTL host-recon burst — CISA AA24-038A — Sentinel via SecurityEvent 4688
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let ReconBins = dynamic(["wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","ping.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","netsh.exe","reg.exe","hostname.exe","qprocess.exe"]);

| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Bin in (ReconBins)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend ParentKey = strcat(Computer, "|", tostring(ProcessId), "|", ParentProcessName)
| summarize
    ReconBinsRun = make_set(Bin, 32),
    DistinctBins = dcount(Bin),
    SampleCmds   = make_set(CommandLine, 16),
    FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated),
    BurstWindow  = bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
  by Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, ParentKey, BurstWindow
| where DistinctBins >= 5
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","explorer.exe","w3wp.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","sshd.exe")
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, DistinctBins, ReconBinsRun, SampleCmds

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\SystemInfo.exe OR *\\ipconfig.exe OR *\\IPCONFIG.EXE OR *\\netstat.exe OR *\\NETSTAT.EXE OR *\\tasklist.exe OR *\\TASKLIST.EXE OR *\\quser.exe OR *\\QUSER.EXE OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\NLTEST.EXE OR *\\ping.exe OR *\\PING.EXE OR *\\arp.exe OR *\\ARP.EXE OR *\\route.exe OR *\\netsh.exe OR *\\NETSH.EXE OR *\\reg.exe OR *\\REG.EXE OR *\\hostname.exe) @ParentImage:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\explorer.exe OR *\\w3wp.exe OR *\\wsmprovhost.exe OR *\\sshd.exe) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:(SYSTEM OR LOCAL\ SERVICE OR NETWORK\ SERVICE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(wmic|net1?|systeminfo|ipconfig|netstat|tasklist|quser|whoami|nltest|ping|arp|route|netsh|reg|hostname|qprocess)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(cmd|powershell|pwsh|explorer|w3wp|wsmprovhost|sshd)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| UserName!=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| ReconBin := regex("\\\\(?<b>[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\.exe)$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false)
| TimeBucket := floor(@timestamp / 300000)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, TimeBucket], function=[count(field=ReconBin, distinct=true, as=DistinctBins), collect([ReconBin], as=BinsRun), collect([CommandLine], as=Cmds), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| DistinctBins >= 5
| sort(field=FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) is uniquely characterised by LOTL-only tradecraft — CISA's AA24-038A flagship advisory and Microsoft's tracking explicitly enumerate wmic, net, systeminfo, ipconfig, netstat, tasklist, quser, whoami and ping as the recon arsenal they run after gaining a foothold via edge-device exploitation. Detecting any single one is noise; the burst-of-5 within 5 minutes

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon credential staging via ntdsutil/vssadmin NTDS.dit copy + archive on domain controllers (Vanguard Panda)
ucs.description: Hunts Volt Typhoon's documented domain-controller credential-theft pattern: ntdsutil 'ifm' or vssadmin shadow-copy invocation to extract NTDS.dit, followed by archival (rar/7z/makecab/tar) and staging in C:\Windows\Temp or an IIS-served path. Microsoft (Volt Typhoon profile) and CISA AA24-038A describe this exact chain as how the group exfiltrates the AD database from compromised DCs ahead of pivoting into OT/critical-infrastructure networks.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmds values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*")) OR (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*create shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*ntds*") OR (Processes.process_name="esentutl.exe" AND Processes.process="*ntds.dit*") OR (Processes.process_name="reg.exe" AND (Processes.process="*save*HKLM\\SYSTEM*" OR Processes.process="*save*HKLM\\SAM*" OR Processes.process="*save*HKLM\\SECURITY*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("rar.exe","winrar.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","makecab.exe","tar.exe") AND (Processes.process="*ntds*" OR Processes.process="*system32\\config*" OR Processes.process="*Windows\\Temp*" OR Processes.process="*inetpub*")) ) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name span=30m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process_name) as actions dc(process_name) as distinct_actions values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(parent_process_name) as parents by dest user | where distinct_actions >= 2 OR mvfind(actions,"ntdsutil.exe")>=0 OR mvfind(actions,"esentutl.exe")>=0 | rename firstTime as _time | convert ctime(_time) ctime(lastTime) | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda — NTDS.dit / SAM credential staging on DCs
let Lookback = 14d;
let Window   = 30m;
let DumpProcs =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where
        (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance ntds"))
     or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "create shadow")
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds")
     or (FileName =~ "esentutl.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds.dit")
     or (FileName =~ "reg.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "save"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"hklm\system",@"hklm\sam",@"hklm\security"))
    | project DumpTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, DumpBin=FileName, DumpCmd=ProcessCommandLine, DumpParent=InitiatingProcessFileName;
let ArchiveProcs =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("rar.exe","winrar.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","makecab.exe","tar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ntds",@"system32\config",@"windows\temp",@"inetpub\wwwroot")
    | project ArchiveTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, AccountName, ArchiveBin=FileName, ArchiveCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
DumpProcs
| join kind=inner ArchiveProcs on DeviceId, AccountName
| where ArchiveTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + Window)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ArchiveTime, DumpTime)
| project DumpTime, ArchiveTime, DelayMin, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DumpBin, DumpCmd, DumpParent, ArchiveBin, ArchiveCmd
| order by DumpTime desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit / SAM Credential Staging (ntdsutil / vssadmin / reg save)
id: 7a1f4b62-9c8e-4a01-bd8a-volt-typhoon-ntds
status: experimental
description: Detects Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) credential-staging via ntdsutil 'ifm', vssadmin shadow-copy of system drive, esentutl on ntds.dit, or reg save of SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY hives — documented in CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft's Volt Typhoon profile.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/05/24/volt-typhoon-targets-us-critical-infrastructure-with-living-off-the-land-techniques/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.t1003.002
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  ntdsutil:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  vss:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'create shadow'
  esentutl:
    Image|endswith: '\esentutl.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'ntds.dit'
  reg_save:
    Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'save'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'hklm\system'
      - 'hklm\sam'
      - 'hklm\security'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (ntdsutil or vss or esentutl or reg_save) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorized AD backups via ntdsutil (verify against change-management window and account)
  - VSS snapshots from sanctioned backup agents (verify ParentImage)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) ( (@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE) @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *"create full"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:*"create shadow"*) OR (@Image:(*\\esentutl.exe OR *\\ESENTUTL.EXE) @CommandLine:*ntds.dit*) OR (@Image:(*\\reg.exe OR *\\REG.EXE) @CommandLine:*save* @CommandLine:(*"hklm\\system"* OR *"hklm\\sam"* OR *"hklm\\security"* OR *"HKLM\\SYSTEM"* OR *"HKLM\\SAM"* OR *"HKLM\\SECURITY"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\rar.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\7z.exe OR *\\7za.exe OR *\\makecab.exe OR *\\tar.exe) @CommandLine:(*ntds* OR *"system32\\config"* OR *"Windows\\Temp"* OR *"inetpub\\wwwroot"*)) ) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| UserName!=/\$$/
| ( (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(ifm|create\s+full|ac\s+i\s+ntds|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/create\s+shadow/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/ntds/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\esentutl\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/ntds\.dit/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\reg\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/save/i AND CommandLine=/hklm\\\\(system|sam|security)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(rar|winrar|7za?|makecab|tar)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(ntds|system32\\\\config|Windows\\\\Temp|inetpub\\\\wwwroot)/i)
  )
| Action := if(ImageFileName=/\\(ntdsutil|vssadmin|wbadmin|esentutl|reg)\.exe$/i, then="DUMP", else="ARCHIVE")
| TimeBucket := floor(@timestamp / 1800000)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, TimeBucket], function=[collect([ImageFileName], as=Bins), collect([CommandLine], as=Cmds), collect([Action], as=Phases), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| Phases=/DUMP/ OR Bins=/ntdsutil|esentutl|vssadmin/i
| sort(field=FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda) is the actor most consistently associated by Microsoft, CrowdStrike and CISA with hands-on-keyboard NTDS.dit theft on domain controllers using ONLY built-in Windows utilities — they specifically avoid mimikatz to stay under EDR. The ntdsutil 'ifm' / vssadmin shadow-copy / reg save SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY chain followed by rar/7z/makecab archiving to Windows\Temp or an IIS
